facts.fact: Sam 在室外美食广场一口气点了双层培根芝士堡、特大份薯条、布朗尼圣代、根汁汽水和三盒小熊软糖。
facts.anchor: a double bacon cheeseburger with an extra-large side of french fries, a brownie fudge sundae, a root beer, and three boxes of gummy bears

facts.fact: Sam 只有十三岁，却擅长假装日子过得很好，家里没人知道他一直在暗中挣扎。
facts.anchor: He might only be thirteen, but Sam was a master at pretending life was fine. No one in his family even knew he’d been struggling.

facts.fact: 吊床对峙原来是玩笑，男孩 Max 的妹妹 Avery 端着 Sam 的餐过来，坐下宣布收“薯条税”。
facts.anchor: Sam looked over Max’s shoulder to see a brown-eyed girl with a pixie cut, holding a tray of what appeared to be Sam’s food.

facts.fact: Avery 认出他是 Sam Sprague，其祖母 Penelope Sprague 是科技大亨，还是 Avery 的偶像。
facts.anchor: “You’re Sam Sprague. And your grandmother is Penelope Sprague, the tech tycoon. She’s, like, my personal hero,” Avery said.

facts.fact: Max 展示 Paradise Platinum Pass，凭它在所有项目可插队，两人约好晚饭后在 Macaw Falls 水上乐园用 AirDrop 传给 Sam。
facts.anchor: “A Paradise Platinum Pass,” Max explained. “You get to cut the lines at every attraction, shop, and excursion.

facts.fact: 晚餐桌上父亲 Elliott 吐露：他在 Sam 这个年纪时父亲去世，此后祖母埋首工作、他们很少见到她。
facts.anchor: I was your age when my dad died, and afterward your grandmother just threw herself into her work. We rarely ever saw her.

facts.fact: Jordan 因试图离家出走被父母没收手机一个月，Sam 因此借不到手机、只能另想办法。
facts.anchor: When Mom and Dad found out what I was planning, they lost it, so no phone for a month.

facts.fact: 章末 Sam 没接受 Jordan“说实话”的建议，暗自藏了一个要保密才能成功的计划。
facts.anchor: One that he’d need to keep to himself if he was going to pull it off.
